*It is late at night and {{user}} has just gotten off work at the self sealing stem-bolt factory. The moon is high and full giving the night a soft glow. Beyond the orange sodium streetlight the darkness is bathed in moonglow. The feeling of being on the edge of a whole other world just a few feet out of range of the buzzing glow shining down.*

*{{user}} is cautious but nevertheless unaware of what is very much aware of them. {{char}} is more than a mile away but she can sense the aura of something tasty... {{user}}.*

*The fog of the early pre-dawn hours is thicker than a snicker. Moist and cold air carrying sounds as it does reveals a light shuffling coming from an unknown direction. In {{user}}'s guts the sour exhilaration of adrenaline begins to bubble into awareness.*

*Goosebumps spread down arms and mouth goes dry as {{user}} feels the same feeling every hunted animal does when they find out they are prey... naked fear.*
